dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Look at these four jobs. Which one would you like, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈlʊk ət ðiːz ˈfɔːr ˈdʒɑːbz. ˈwɪtʃ ˈwʌn wʊd juː ˈlaɪk, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd love to be a zookeeper. I love animals!
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlʌv tə bi ə ˈzuːkiːpər. aɪ ˈlʌv ˈænɪməlz!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Would you like to be a firefighter?
dialogue.reading: wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə bi ə ˈfaɪərfaɪtər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I wouldn't. It's very dangerous.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈwʊdənt. ɪts ˈvɛri ˈdeɪndʒərəs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I wouldn't like to be a hairdresser. My hair always looks terrible!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwʊdənt ˈlaɪk tə bi ə ˈhɛrdrɛsər. maɪ ˈhɛr ˈɔːlweɪz ˈlʊks ˈtɛrəbəl!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'd love to be a programmer. I'd make apps for students!
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlʌv tə bi ə ˈproʊɡræmər. aɪd ˈmeɪk ˈæps fər ˈstuːdənts!
